Hmm even on support, lambda2 is ~0 (numerical noise). Looking at evals - second eigenvalue is ~0 too, then 5.0. So the spatial support still has multiple connected components among active nodes? num ~...
Largest CC of spatial has lambda2 ≈ 15 - that's the useful metric. Full W has lambda2 ≈ 0.001 (weakly connected all-to-all with varying weights).
